page.overview:
Who is Flash Sentry?

Flash Sentry's human counterpart appears in the My Little Pony Equestria Girls franchise. He is a student at Canterlot High School, electric guitarist for the band "Flash Drive", and Sunset Shimmer's ex-boyfriend.

On May 16, 2013, Meghan McCarthy wrote on Twitter, "So funny people are calling blue haired guy in [https://twitter.com/search?q=%23EquestriaGirls&src=hash #EquestriaGirls] 'Brad.' His name is obviously 'Dreamy Cutebottom' [https://twitter.com/search?q=%23notreally&src=hash #notreally]."

Flash does not appear in the script for the IDW comics' My Little Pony: Equestria Girls Holiday Special.

When Sunset Shimmer frames Twilight for ruining the Fall Formal decorations using photographic proof, Flash Sentry proves that the photos are fake and Vice Principal Luna allows Twilight Sparkle to continue running for Fall Formal princess. Twilight is so thrilled that she hugs Flash Sentry. He asks Twilight out to the Formal, but he mistakes her panicked "no's" as her response.
